g.text: Longer sync intervals raise conflict rates
Four agents; no dependency; relocation 0. Dashed model C(n,2)pλ²τ applies only to overlap pairs.
95% normal intervals across available seeds; conflict size excludes seeds with no conflict.
Short-edit conflict sizes remain nearly flat; vertical scales differ between columns.
